ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.35:0.65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white fields are localized to the distal ends of both lobes. The left lobe contains a large contiguous white region with high-frequency dark mottling (speckling). The right lobe displays a smaller, tapered white field at the tip with dense black fragmentation. The medial and proximal areas are characterized by a solid, low-intensity black pixel field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; vertex angle approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 1/10th of the vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing boundary. Left lobe: 12-14 small, consistent peaks. Right lobe: 8-10 peaks with higher amplitude and greater pixel-distance between peaks, culminating in a jagged distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, sweeping upward from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A localized cluster of high-contrast, circular white pixel groups is visible on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel high-intensity linear marks (rake marks) are visible on the mid-left lobe, oriented diagonally. Two faint, intersecting linear marks are visible on the right lobe, adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks across both lobes; a visible irregular notch or indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately mid-way between the notch and tip.
